value.message: Halton Region's site lists Kids & Me drop-in groups for ages up to 6: Tuesdays 9:30-11am at St. Andrew's United Church, Georgetown, and Thursdays 10:30am-12pm at the Acton Library branch - both free. Links2Care also runs EarlyON Centres in Acton and Georgetown for birth to 6, though their page doesn't list times.
